mechanism: Selegiline is a selective monoamine oxidase-B inhibitor that can potentiate monoaminergic effects; melatonin may enhance serotonergic and noradrenergic activity, creating potential for serotonin syndrome and excessive CNS stimulation.
action: Monitor for symptoms of serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia) and excessive CNS stimulation; consider melatonin dose adjustment or alternative sleep aid if symptoms emerge.
